items.title: Blingy Teens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Who's ready to discover new trends? The city is full of new teens that have brought fresh fashion trends and vibes with them. Choose from the best outfits made for you and steal the spotlight from your friends! Explore the town with your new style and find more friends that share the same taste in style as you!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Seaside Story
items.creator: Gamemode One
items.description: Live out your own peaceful ocean adventure! Go fishing and discover amazing creatures in brand new ocean biomes. Customize your boat, upgrade the island, and fill the aquarium with the fish you catch. Full of secrets to discover, friends to make, and ecosystems to clean, it's time to start your seaside story!

items.title: MASKED TEENS
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Sometimes all you need is a mask to live your dream.

17 HD (128px) skins including:

- 16 masked outfits and colors
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: TOP 10 v2
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Looking for a fresh style? These skins will blow you away! Here is the second release of Top 10 for Minecraft! For all gamers.

10 HD (128px) skins including:


- 9 trending outfits
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Anime Pastels
items.creator: Plank
items.description:
Can't choose between super cute or ultra cool? Don't worry... we got you covered! 

Now you can have the best of both, pastel colors and anime! You and your friends can rock the streets in ultimate cute fashion, or simply stay home and watch anime all day. The choice is yours!

- 4 female skins
- 4 male skins
-Made by: Plank Digital

items.title: ROCKETS!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: ROCKETS! let's you launch a rocket spaceship into space! Jump in a rocket and take off!

items.title: Grunge Bikers
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Put on your grunge jacket and hop on your bike to ride amongst your fellow biker friends!

+ 8 biker skins!
+ Free skin: Jasmine
+ Fashion, sturdy & brave!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Japanese Festival
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Impress friends with your own festive fashion to enjoy the annual Japanese traditions!

+ 10 Festive skins
+ FREE skin: Izumi
+ Festive, fashion & seasonal!

By FTB

items.title: Halloween Demons
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
Bo-ho-ho! Halloween is demons' favourite time of the year when they can embrace their true power and be themselves. Join their team and become the scariest squad in the town!
- 12 scary skins
- 1 free skin

items.title: Vogue Outfits
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
It's time to shine! Wear the ultimate outfits, become the most famous in town and have a lot of fun with your friends. Run the city and the Minecraft world with style!
- 12 styled outfits
- 1 free skin

items.title: Hunters VS Runners
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Can you collect all the diamonds from the safes before the hunters catch you? You have to be quick, use the speed-ups and escape from the safes when the alarm goes off!

- Safes set off alarms when the runner breaks into them
- Custom city
- Speed-ups
- Play with multiple runners and hunters
- Tutorial
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Music Waves
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These colorful music wave skins are just what you need for any Minecraft party or concert! Show everyone how you vibe and move to the music. Which of these colorful rainbow sound waves is your favorite?

items.title: Glitch Ninjas
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Ninjas are already fierce and brave warriors that jet through the air. Admired for their talent and skills, these glitch ninjas are unlike any other! They can teleport through solid objects and devices! Roleplay as a glitchy karate chopping hero and protect your village!

items.title: Halloween Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Defeat the dragon in style with your Halloween costume, and still have limited resources on your little islands of the classic skyblock!

+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Secret Cave Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have a secret life away from everyone, and with a lot of luxury! The secret mansion awaits you hidden in the deepest caves.

+ Amazing hidden mansion
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Labyrinth
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Explore a vast network of mazes in search of the exit. Can you escape the Labyrinth?
-Twenty levels
-By Nigtmarez

items.title: Mob Animatronics 2 HD
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These scary mob animatronics are back for more action and fright! Try out ten new mobs to roleplay and scare your friends with. Great for celebrating Halloween or spooky maps.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Mob Animatronics HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
You've been created out of metal, plastic, and other materials with mob inspiration. Roleplay as one of ten different scary animatronics and jump scare your friends! Passive and hostile mobs included.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Parkour Races
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Do you like parkour, and do you like having a lot of fun? Then challenge your friends to a parkour race! Choose from 3 different levels of difficulty, and race towards the finish line. 

+ Play singleplayer or, even more fun, multiplayer
+ 4 teams (several people can be on the same team)
+ Includes 8 skins
By: Artifact Studios & Norvale

items.title: Lakeside Retreat
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Come explore this beautiful lakeside cabin retreat where all the fun of fall camp awaits. Play camp games with your friends and explore the area where mining caves and rustic camp sites hide among the trees.

- Abandoned iron mine with surprises
- Apiary
- Animal and crop farms
- Custom loon with nighttime nature sounds

- By BTWN

items.title: CIRCUS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The circus is in town! Grab these awesome themed skins and become the ultimate circus legend!

+ Multiple skins
+ By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: DRAGON GODS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These dragons are ready for battle!

+ Includes dragon themed skins

items.title: Color Fade
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Tired of the usual trendy streetwear skins? Want something a bit more abstract, but that still rocks? We've you covered with the stylish yet clean looking color fade skins! Pick your favourite color combination and rock it with style in your favourite gamemode or server!

- 15 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: The Spiral Curse Prologue
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: See where the curse began in the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Before the adventure within the multicolored temple started, the chosen hero began combating the curse in simpler ways. See how the hero adventured bravely amongst the snow covered peaks and grass strewn valleys to find their master in The Spiral Curse Prologue!
